faces.name: Kyoko Igarashi [Love Letter]

info.Card Set: EX Crossover Set "THE IDOLM@STER CINDERELLA GIRLS"

faces.text: Give your leader {icon_hp|[defense]}+1. Draw a card.
faces.raw_text: Give your leader {icon_hp|[defense]}+1. Draw a card.

qa.title: Q2077 (Apr. 17, 2026)
qa.question: Can I play this card as a spell from my EX area if I pay 4 play points?
qa.answer: Yes. If you play this card as a spell, your leader gains 1 defense, and you draw a card. After resolving its effect, you put it into your cemetery. Then, because this card is a token, you remove it from play.

qa.title: Q2076 (Apr. 17, 2026)
qa.question: What does "At the start of the game, if your deck is based on the THE IDOLM@STER CINDERELLA GIRLS universe, put 5 Magical Item tokens into your EX area" mean?
qa.answer: If your leader, deck, and evolve deck consist solely of THE IDOLM@STER CINDERELLA GIRLS cards, you may declare that it is based on the THE IDOLM@STER CINDERELLA GIRLS universe at the start of the game. (In normal play, your deck must be either based on a single class or a universe.) If you do, you must put 5 Magical Item tokens into your EX area at the start of the game.

qa.title: Q2075 (Apr. 17, 2026)
qa.question: Is this card a Magical Item?
qa.answer: Yes. There are several varieties of Magical Item token, but as far as gameplay is concerned, they are all the same card, so you may use any combination of them.
